name: Harper
self_text: I am a Kenyan in my 40s who enjoys podcasting. I use Sony gear and love discussing equipment. I am looking for a relaxed photo walk, though I tend to go at a fast pace. I am cool with not taking portraits of each other. Most weeks, I can do Sunday afternoon.

requests.request_text: I need you to be available Sunday afternoon and you have to be okay with either a fast pace or a moderate pace. I'd strongly prefer that you are okay with not taking portraits of each other, though I won't rule you out over it. It would be a small bonus if you are fine with plenty of gear talk or if gear talk is fine but not the point.
